decisions.reason: As a niche naval product with only minimal website presence and many competing internal options, its option value likely resolved negatively, so we drop it.
This core general interior luminaire fits our main market and has low carrying cost, so we keep it while its option value remains.
It is a flagship pendant aligned with our strategic human-centric and microprismatic direction, so we keep it.
Similar to the already-dropped HMI searchlight, this marine searchlight is non-core and only minimally promoted, so with many other options we drop it.
